sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球供应链制造母港、跨境电商货源地与外资合规准入市场

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Retail of Automotive Replacement Parts and Tuning Accessories

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Civil law with commercial regulatory overlay; distinct from mainland China's socialist legal system)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Cross-Strait Bilateral Investment Protection and Promotion Agreement (2012)
AGREEMENT on Trade in Services between Trade and Economic Cooperation Committee (as amended under ECFA framework)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Taiwan Company Act (Article 386, Chapter V, as amended in 2018) requires the domestic company to maintain a shareholder register and, where the shareholder is a foreign legal person, to disclose the chain of control up to the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO). The Money Laundering Control Act (所述洗錢防制法, 1996 as amended through 2018) and the Anti-Money Latering and Countering Terrorism Financing Regulations governing designated non-financial businesses, as enforced by the Ministry of Economic Affairs and the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC), mandate customer due diligence, risk-based AML/CFT programs, and UBO record-keeping.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation (Business License) of the ultimate parent company (People's Republic of China)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) / local Market and Regulatory Administration of the PRC
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by a Chinese notary office, followed by verification by the Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) in Taiwan; not a Hague Apostille because the PRC is not a party to the Hague Convention for Taiwan relations

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing or equivalent official extract on corporate standing of the parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (market supervision, PRC)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Local notarization in PRC + SEF original document verification (consular-path substitute)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of the parent company authorizing the Taiwan WFOE formation and appointment of the local legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the PRC parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized company minutes in the PRC, certified by the notary, then verified by SEF

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport or national ID card of the designated Taiwan legal representative and of each shareholder/UBO, as required by UBO filing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing government (PRC or Taiwan, as applicable)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy by a PRC notary or Taiwan notary, then submitted to Taiwan Company and Commerce Registration Authority; where issued in mainland China, SEF verification required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, and commercial counterparties against (i) Taiwan's domestic anti-terrorism designation list under the Terrorism Financing Prevention Act, (ii) United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list, (iii) U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) SDN list, and (iv) the PRC sanctions/export-control database, where relevant. The AML compliance officer must document this screening prior to incorporation and update the file at least every 6 months or upon any significant stakeholder change; any positive hit requires enhanced due diligence and disclosure to the Taiwanese FSC.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Ministry of Economic Affairs – Company One-Stop Service (公司與商業一站式線上申辦系統) at https://onestop.nat.gov.tw
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in traditional Chinese characters; English transliteration may be added as a separate business designation but does not replace the Chinese registered name for legal purposes. The name must clearly identify the limited liability nature of the entity; transliterations into the Latin alphabet are accepted only as an auxiliary, not as the authoritative name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Tax evasion or illegal finance terms
Geographical monopolies or false sovereign designations
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the company name pre-screening is rejected, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal to the Department of Commerce, Ministry of Economic Affairs, within 30 days of the rejection notice. The appeal must detail the reasons the proposed name complies with Article 18 of the Company Act. If the administrative appeal is denied, the applicant may institute an administrative litigation before the Taipei High Administrative Court; the time limit for litigation is two months from receipt of the administrative decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A registered office in Taiwan is mandatory. A pure virtual office providing only a postal/mail-forwarding address is generally tolerated for low-risk e-commerce retail operations, but it must not be a mere P.O. Box; the registered location must be able to accept service of legal process and the local representative must be physically reachable during normal business hours. Where the Taiwan WFOE carries on cross-border e-commerce but maintains no physical employees in Taiwan, tax and substance authorities may require an affiliate service agreement or a local agent; virtual office arrangements are not automatically prohibited but are subject to scrutiny on substance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate: for a Standard_low-risk e-commerce auto-parts retailer, the unannounced on-site inspection likelihood is estimated at 7–12% per year. This probability increases if the entity fails to maintain complete UBO records or shows high-risk transactional patterns, including frequent same-day round-tripping or sales to sanctioned jurisdictions.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration fee based on authorized capital, minimum bracket fee applicable since no minimum capital is required

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate common seal (official company chop) engravement
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for standard corporate seal

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of cross-strait documents (certificate of incorporation, board resolution, ID/passport copies)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Chinese Notary Public (PRC, place of parent company)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Chinese notary fee schedule (Jin Cheng Bench Notary Fee Statute), per document notarial deed

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for certified translation with translator liability

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal counsel retainer for UBO structure drafting, AML compliance manual, PEP/sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Taiwan law firm licensed under the Lawyers Act
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; fixed fee for pre-incorporation due diligence and AML/CFT policy package

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office and local agent service (virtual office plus registered agent, annual)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Private market service; no statutory cap

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Accounting agent appointment and opening of corporate bank account (mandatory prior to capital contribution)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for WFOE bank account-KYC facilitation fee; bank charges may be separate

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act, Republic of China (Taiwan), Articles 18 (name pre-audit), 128-131, 156 (share capital), 200-201, 273, 387 (registration and electronic filing); Act Governing Relations between the People of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area, Article 73; Mainland Area People Investing in Taiwan Permission and Supervision Regulations; Company Registration Dossier Regulations; Company Registration Fee Collection Regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Department of Commercial Development, Company Registration Division; electronic filing venue is the MOEA Integrated Commercial Administration Portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Company Registration for a Company Limited by Shares, together with Articles of Incorporation, first board meeting minutes, written consents of directors and supervisors, CPA capital verification report, and the Investment Commission investment approval letter; submitted through the MOEA Company Registration E-filing System.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital under Article 156 of the Companies Act. However, a Mainland Chinese investor must obtain a pre-incorporation investment permit from the MOEA Investment Commission, remit the full declared investment amount in foreign currency into a dedicated NT-dollar capital verification account at an authorized Taiwanese foreign-exchange bank operating as a statutory escrow-type account, and procure a licensed CPA capital verification report before the MOEA registration application; capital and share ownership may not be reduced or transferred without subsequent Investment Commission approval.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) that the subscription to the Company's issued ordinary shares, amounting to NT$1,000,000 divided into 100,000 shares of NT$10 each and fully paid as verified by the CPA capital verification report dated [date], is hereby ratified and accepted; (2) that the registered office stated in Article 3 of the Articles of Incorporation is hereby adopted as the Company's statutory seat; (3) that [Officer Name] is appointed Chairperson, [Officer Name] Managing Director, and [Officer Name] legal representative of the Company; and (4) that the Chairperson, jointly with any one director, is hereby authorized to execute incorporation filings, open bank accounts, and sign all registration documents before the Ministry of Economic Affairs.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA Investment Commission)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Mainland Area Investor Application for Investment Permission in duplicate, with notarized investor identification, through the MOEA Investment Commission online submission service and by post. The Commission screens the proposed auto-parts online retail business against the Mainland Investment Negative List; ISIC 4791 online retail of automotive replacement parts is not a prohibited industry and may be approved subject to compliance with Article 73 of the Cross-Strait Relations Act. Upon favorable review, the Commission issues a formal Investment Approval Letter which must be quoted in all subsequent incorporation filings.
required_dossiers: Notarized identity certificate of the mainland investor
Investment permission application form for mainland area people
Financial statements, bank credit certificate or audited accounts of the investing entity
Business plan and feasibility report for auto-parts e-commerce operation
Affidavit declaring no involvement in prohibited industries and agreeing to Article 73 restrictions
Draft Articles of Incorporation and preliminary capital schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Commission issues a rectification letter, supplement the requested documents within 30 days; if approval is denied, the investor may file an administrative reconsideration petition with the Executive Yuan within 30 days of service of the decision, followed by administrative litigation before the Taipei High Administrative Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name and Business Scope Pre-Audit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Department of Commercial Development, Name and Business Scope Pre-Audit Module
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the company name and business scope pre-audit application together with the investment approval letter on the MOEA commercial administration portal. The company must adopt a non-duplicated Chinese trade name and register its scope item corresponding to online retail of automotive replacement parts and tuning accessories according to the Uniform Business Scope Catalogue. The system issues a Name Pre-Audit Certificate which is valid for six months.
required_dossiers: Company name and business scope pre-audit application form
Investment Approval Letter issued by the Investment Commission
Payment receipt for the NT$300 name pre-audit fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name conflicts with an existing registered company or trademark, refile with up to three alternative names within two months; if the scope codes are rejected, realign the scope with the Uniform Business Scope Catalogue and resubmit, or request a special pre-audit review by the MOEA.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Remittance, Statutory Escrow Account Opening and CPA Capital Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized foreign-exchange bank in Taiwan and a certified public accountant licensed by the Financial Supervisory Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a NT-dollar capital verification deposit account under the proposed company name at an authorized Taiwanese bank. The mainland investor remits the total approved investment amount in foreign currency; after conversion the bank issues a Foreign Exchange Remittance Certificate and deposit confirmation. Engage a Taiwan-licensed CPA to examine the remittance inflow and issue a Capital Verification Report under Article 156 of the Companies Act, confirming that all subscribed ordinary shares are fully paid.
required_dossiers: Investment Approval Letter from the MOEA Investment Commission
SWIFT or interbank remittance confirmation and bank certificate of deposit
Capital allocation schedule and share subscription list
CPA engagement letter and draft Articles of Incorporation
Identification documents of the sole shareholder and proposed officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If remittance is blocked by banking anti-money-laundering checks, provide source-of-funds evidence to the bank; if the inbound amount is less than the approved amount, obtain a reduced-capital approval from the Investment Commission before the CPA issues the verification report.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Incorporation Filing with the MOEA and Integrated Tax Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MOEA Department of Commercial Development, Company Registration Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the electronic company incorporation application through the MOEA Company Registration E-filing System using the digital certificate of the proposed legal representative. Upload the approved Articles of Incorporation, first board resolution minutes, written consents of directors and supervisors, CPA capital verification report, Investment Commission approval letter, registered office proof, and company seal record. The single registration grant covers the company setup, integrated tax and business registration, and issuance of the Company Registration Certificate and Unified Business Number.
required_dossiers: Approved Articles of Incorporation
First board resolution minutes and appointment resolutions
Written consents of directors and supervisors
CPA capital verification report
Investment Approval Letter issued by the Investment Commission
Registered office lease agreement or title certificate
Company chop and seal record
Passport or national ID copies of the directors, supervisor and legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a rectification order under Article 388 of the Companies Act, the applicant must make corrections within 15 days; if registration is denied, the applicant may appeal to the MOEA and thereafter file an administrative reconsideration with the Executive Yuan.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration VAT, Labor, Import and E-Commerce Compliance Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance, Labor Insurance Administration, and Bureau of Foreign Trade
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 15 days after incorporation, apply to the regional National Taxation Bureau for a Uniform Invoice Purchase Certificate and confirm business tax registration. Register the employees with the Labor Insurance Administration for labor insurance and pension annuities. If goods will be imported from mainland China or third countries, register as an importer with the Bureau of Foreign Trade under the newly issued Unified Business Number. Execute e-commerce platform payment contracts, including Stripe and PayPal, using the registered company name, Unified Business Number and corporate bank account.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Certificate and Unified Business Number
Uniform Invoice Purchase Certificate application form and seal card
Labor insurance and occupational pension registration forms
Manager mandate resolution and identification documents
Corporate bank account confirmation certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late registration is subject to administrative penalties; cure by filing late and requesting a first-time leniency; refusal of VAT registration may be remedied through an application to the regional National Taxation Bureau review committee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not triggered for pure online retail under ISIC 4791; if the company later establishes a physical warehouse or light assembly facility, the MOEA Industrial Development Department and the local city labor affairs bureau would become competent for factory and workplace approvals.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industry-specific operating license applies to online retail of automotive replacement parts and tuning accessories; the Company Registration Certificate, integrated business tax registration and Uniform Invoice entitlement constitute the sole operational prerequisites.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment, Taiwan, regulatory successor to the Environmental Protection Administration
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt; pure online retail and trade of automotive replacement parts is not an activity listed in the Environmental Impact Assessment Act annexes, and no EIA report or registration is mandatory; only a general business waste disposal contract is required under the Waste Disposal Act for office and packaging residuals.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No discharge or emission thresholds are triggered at formation stage. If the company later establishes a distribution warehouse, the operator must comply with the Air Pollution Control Act for volatile organic compound and fugitive emission limits, the Waste Disposal Act manifest and online declaration for used packaging and scrap metal, and the Water Pollution Control Act if any parts washing or process water is introduced without a permit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety: the registered office must maintain valid fire safety equipment and submit a fire protection self-inspection report to the local fire department where the premises exceed the floor-area threshold; the lessor must hold the applicable Fire Services Act compliance certificate. Occupational: offices and warehouses must conform to the Occupational Safety and Health Act, including a general safety and health management plan for workplaces with 30 or more employees; any added warehouse mezzanine or racking system requires a structural load inspection certificate from a licensed professional engineer and a workplace clearance from the local labor authority. Civil Defense: no special civil defense license is required for low-risk retail services; premises classified as public gathering places exceeding the Building Technical Regulations threshold require an application to the local construction authority for use compliance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (国家税务总局, SAT), administered through provincial and municipal tax service bureaus; e-filing portal: 全国统一规范电子税务局 (Nationwide Unified Electronic Tax Bureau) at https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn; export clearance and customs declaration linkage via the China International Trade Single Window (中国国际贸易单一窗口, https://www.singlewindow.cn).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Under the multi-license integration reform (多证合一), the WFOE obtains its PRC tax identity automatically upon incorporation: the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (统一社会信用代码) issued by the SAMR business registry is the statutory TIN and VAT taxpayer identification number. Within 30 days of incorporation, the WFOE must activate tax registration through the Electronic Tax Bureau, complete real-name verification (实名办税) for the legal representative and financial officer, file bank account reporting (银行账户报告), accounting system filing (财务会计制度备案), and invoice type/quota determination (发票票种核定). Foreign shareholders supply notarized and legalized incorporation documents and file the Foreign Investment Information Report (外商投资信息报告) via the MOFCOM platform. No separate VAT ID is issued; the USCC is used for all VAT, CIT, customs, and export refund filings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; a domestically incorporated WFOE is a PRC tax resident under Art. 2 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law, taxed at 25% CIT on worldwide income with foreign tax credit relief; Territorial_Scope is worldwide. VAT classification defaults to small-scale taxpayer if annual turnover is below CNY 5,000,000, unless general taxpayer status is elected or mandatory; no pass-through election exists; cross-border e-commerce retail exporters may additionally apply a deemed taxable income ratio of 4% for CIT purposes under SAT Announcement [2019] No. 36.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: PRC law provides no check-the-box or hybrid mismatch pass-through election; available mechanisms include: (i) election of VAT general taxpayer status for small-scale taxpayers with sound accounting, enabling input VAT refunds at the 13% output rate; (ii) cross-border e-commerce retail export election between 'exemption with input VAT refund' (有票退税) and 'exemption without refund' (无票免税) under Caishui [2018] No. 103, extended through 2025; (iii) export refund management category (一/二/三/四类) affecting pre-refund examination and FX substantiation; (iv) transfer pricing APA and contemporaneous documentation elections; (v) GAAR-based hybrid mismatch self-adjustment — hybrid entities are not recognized for PRC tax purposes.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (增值税, PRC Value-Added Tax); Consumption Tax is not applicable to auto aftermarket parts. Destination-side note: Taiwan importation of physical auto parts triggers Taiwan customs duty and 5% Business Tax (加值型营业税) collected at importation from the consignee; low-value consignments under TWD 2,000 are exempt from Taiwan import VAT; the PRC WFOE does not acquire Taiwan indirect tax nexus unless it establishes a fixed place of business in Taiwan or acts as the importer of record.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: CNY 5,000,000 annual taxable sales (rolling 12-month cumulative 应征增值税销售额) is the mandatory VAT general taxpayer registration threshold; below this threshold the WFOE registers as a small-scale taxpayer with a 3% levy rate (temporarily reduced to 1% through 2027). All entities must obtain a VAT/TIN identity (USCC) from business commencement; there is no economic turnover de minimis exemption from registration. Taiwan-side: a foreign enterprise selling goods to Taiwan consumers via Taiwan online platforms with annual sales above TWD 480,000 may require Taiwan Business Tax registration, although for physical goods this obligation generally falls on the Taiwan importer.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory fully digitalized e-invoicing (数电票/全电发票) through the national Electronic Invoice Service Platform under Golden Tax Phase IV (金税四期): every VAT invoice is issued with a 20-digit invoice number, QR code, and real-time upload to the tax authority's central invoice database at the moment of issuance. No physical tax-control device (税务UKey) is required for 数电票; enterprises integrate via the VAT Invoice Comprehensive Service Platform using API/XML interfaces for purchase and sales reconciliation. E-invoices are the only compliant invoice type for general VAT taxpayers. Customs export declarations are cleared through the Single Window system and automatically matched in real time with invoice data and bank FX receipts.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export sale of China-origin automotive aftermarket parts to Taiwan qualifies for VAT zero-rating (零税率) and export tax refund (出口退税). General-taxpayer WFOEs apply the 免抵退 (exemption-offset-refund) method for self-manufactured goods, recovering input VAT up to the applicable export rebate rate (standard 13% for auto parts). Cross-border e-commerce retail exports under customs supervision codes 9610 (B2C parcels), 9710 (B2B direct), and 9810 (overseas warehouse) may elect 'refund with purchase invoices' (有票退税) or, absent valid VAT special invoices, 'exemption without refund' (无票免税), provided that: (i) the exporter is a registered cross-border e-commerce enterprise, (ii) goods are physically exported through PRC customs, (iii) payment is received from overseas consumers or entities, and (iv) per-transaction value limits are satisfied. Foreign exchange must generally be received within 180 days from the customs export date; the operative export refund declaration deadline is April 30 of the year following the export year, and refund rights lapse if the filing window is missed absent special approval.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration Form (出口货物报关单) with export-refund special seal, obtained via China International Trade Single Window
Export invoice / commercial invoice (出口发票/商业发票) and packing list (装箱单)
VAT special invoice of domestic purchase (增值税专用发票) evidencing input VAT for the 有票退税 route, or a statutory exemption declaration for the 无票免税 route
Bill of Lading (海运提单), Air Waybill (航空运单), or Express/Postal Waybill (快递/邮政运单) proving outbound carriage from PRC customs territory
Bank inward remittance certificate / foreign exchange receipt voucher (银行收汇凭证/结汇水单)
Cross-border e-commerce order, payment, and logistics electronic data (订单、支付、物流电子信息) for 9610/9710/9810 declarations
Export Tax Refund Application Form set (出口退（免）税申报表, export refund module of the Electronic Tax Bureau)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: SAT Golden Tax IV performs automated cross-matching of customs export declarations, e-invoice issuance, and bank FX receipts. Anomaly triggers — abnormal FX settlement routing, inflated invoice prices, mismatched HS codes, excessive conversion-cost ratios (换汇成本), and false customs declarations — expose the WFOE to: (i) rejection of the refund application and re-classification as deemed domestic sale (视同内销补税) with a 0.05% daily late-payment surcharge; (ii) retrospective clawback of all refunded VAT; (iii) administrative penalties of 100%–500% of the fraudulently obtained refund, suspension of export refund rights, and downgrade to the most severe Category IV credit rating under Art. 66 of the PRC Tax Administration Law; (iv) criminal liability under Art. 204 of the PRC Criminal Law (骗取出口退税罪), with a prosecution threshold of approximately RMB 100,000 defrauded, escalating to 5–10 years' imprisonment for 'huge amounts' and 10 years to life imprisonment (无期徒刑) with fines of 100%–500% or property confiscation for 'especially huge amounts'; and (v) unlimited retrospective recovery — fraud claims are not subject to the ordinary 3/5-year limitation periods — plus joint disciplinary blacklisting (联合惩戒) barring responsible individuals from new export refund registrations.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (国家外汇管理局, SAFE), operating under the People's Bank of China (中国人民银行, PBOC). SAFE holds exclusive regulatory competence over current-account trade settlement verification, capital-account registration (FDI, external debt, outbound investment), and the licensing of cross-border payment institutions; PBOC exercises bank-supervisory authority over corporate account opening, AML/KYC, and payment-system licensing.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: RMB is convertible for current-account items (goods, services, and dividends legally derived from after-tax profits) subject to transaction-authenticity review at the settlement bank; capital-account items remain tiered and require SAFE registration or case-by-case approval. The WFOE may open a capital-goods account for inbound equity injection, noting that PRC law currently imposes no statutory minimum paid-in capital for this entity type. Capital conversion follows the voluntary-settlement (意愿结汇) model with payment-by-use authenticity checks and a negative list that prohibits diversion to securities investment, entrusted loans, or non-owner-occupied real-estate purchases. Profit-remittance hurdles: completion of the annual statutory audit by a PRC CPA firm, corporate income tax settlement and clearance, 10% dividend withholding for Taiwan-resident shareholders (no cross-strait double-tax agreement is in force, so no treaty reduction is available), adoption of a board resolution, and SAFE verification of undistributed profits against audited financial statements at the paying bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Mandatory foreign-currency surrender has been abolished; the statutory conversion ratio is 0%, and the WFOE is free to retain export proceeds in foreign currency or to convert them voluntarily. However, proceeds must be repatriated to China and reconciled within the bank's trade-forex monitoring file; SAFE's trade-in-goods regime treats proceeds collected later than 90 days after the customs declaration date as delayed-collection items requiring self-reporting through the Trade Foreign Exchange Monitoring System, and retention of export proceeds offshore beyond the prescribed repatriation window (generally 6 months from the customs declaration date) requires prior SAFE approval. For marketplace e-commerce exports collected through Stripe/PayPal rails, the WFOE must be registered in SAFE's Trade Foreign Exchange Income and Expenditure Enterprise Roster, maintain A-class status, and pass all settlements through either a licensed Chinese cross-border payment institution conducting centralized collection with segmented settlement reporting, or an onshore export-proceeds account matched to customs declarations under the 9610/9710/1210 e-commerce customs regimes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (资本金账户) and General Operational Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Export-Proceeds Foreign-Currency Settlement Account
Operational Account with integrated cross-border e-commerce collection, RMB/FX treasury, and payroll services
Capital Escrow Account and Multi-Currency Operational Account (USD/CNY/HKD) with Greater-China cross-border onboarding capability
Operational Account and Trade-Finance Account for letters of credit and import settlements

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: MEDIUM-HIGH as an offshore collection rail, LOW as an onshore account substitute. A foreign EMI without a PBOC Payment Business License (支付业务许可证) cannot open a domestic RMB settlement account, acquire onshore merchants, or perform RMB clearing. PayPal is lawful only through PayPal China's licensed acquisition platform; Stripe holds no PRC license and cannot onboard a mainland WFOE directly, so the WFOE must either operate a Hong Kong/Singapore merchant entity to connect to Stripe, or use a licensed Chinese cross-border collection processor (PingPong, LianLian, Airwallex, Payoneer) that provides a virtual foreign-currency collection account in the processor's name and settles export proceeds into the WFOE's commercial bank account under SAFE transaction-level reporting. Each settlement batch must carry matching e-commerce transaction data, customs declarations, and logistics evidence to withstand bank and SAFE authenticity review.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: First-time corporate basic-account opening mandates physical presence of the legal representative (法定代表人) at a mainland branch counter for the face-to-face KYC interview, together with the original business license, the complete company seal set, and proof of actual operating premises. Banks routinely perform an on-site inspection of the registered business address before account activation, and remote opening is not available for the first account. Where the WFOE's legal representative is resident outside mainland China (e.g., Taiwan), banks generally accept a notarized power of attorney and in-person appearance of a China-based financial officer, and certain banks with Greater-China networks permit the foreign representative to complete identity verification at a Hong Kong or Taiwan branch for forwarding; however, pure video-remote KYC for new corporate accounts is not accepted under PBOC banking-supervision and anti-fraud guidance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: E-commerce red flag: high-volume, low-ticket micro-transactions settled through third-party PSPs (PayPal/Stripe) with settlement batches obscuring the underlying buyer identity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform store contracts, PSP payout statements and batch reconciliation files, order-level transaction ledgers, 9610/9710 customs declaration records, logistics carrier waybills, warehouse consignment agreements, and an adopted AML transaction-monitoring policy manual

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Round-tripping indicators: frequent FX conversions and same-day in-and-out fund flows disproportionate to the inventory turnover of auto-aftermarket parts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board-approved annual funds plan, capital-account utilization ledger (资本金使用台账), supplier purchase contracts with matched payment vouchers, VAT and corporate income tax filings, inventory stock counts, and a documented business-substance narrative

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-strait related-party exposure: payments to Taiwan shareholders or Taiwan-based suppliers lacking arm's-length documentation
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Foreign-investment information filing receipt, Taiwan investor identity and corporate registration certificates, intercompany and commercial agreements with market-comparable pricing, contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation (转让定价同期资料), customs import/export declarations, and full settlement-instruction history

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Virtual or co-working registered address used by an online-only retailer, increasing the risk of shell-company classification
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid lease contract, on-site photographs and inventory/warehouse evidence, utility bills, payroll and social-insurance contribution records, VAT invoicing history, and full cooperation with the bank's pre-activation site inspection

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report of the Enterprise (企业年度报告) filed through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) — local market supervision bureau at the WFOE's registered address
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June covering the prior calendar year; the online declaration window opens on 1 January
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance triggers inclusion in the List of Enterprises with Abnormal Operations within 10 working days after 30 June; continuous non-rectification for three consecutive years escalates to the Serious Illegal and Dishonest Enterprise List with financing, procurement, and legal-representative credit and travel restrictions; persistent default may lead to administrative revocation of the business license and compulsory deregistration (administrative strike-off).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Foreign Investment Information Report (外商投资信息报告年度报告), including FDI stock/equity-interest data
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) and State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) via the integrated SAMR annual-report declaration portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 June, filed concurrently with the SAMR annual report for the prior calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Where the WFOE fails to rectify after a MOFCOM correction order, an administrative fine of RMB 100,000–500,000 (approximately USD 14,000–70,000) applies to the enterprise, with RMB 10,000–50,000 on directly responsible personnel; supplemental SAFE foreign-exchange review sanctions may also apply.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Enterprise Income Tax Annual Settlement Return (企业所得税年度汇算清缴申报) with attached audited financial statements and required related-party transaction schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) — in-charge tax authority at the WFOE's registration location
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 May following the calendar tax year, within the five-month annual clearance period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per day on the unpaid tax amount; late-filing penalties of up to RMB 2,000 in ordinary cases or RMB 10,000 in aggravated cases; where understatement or evasion is determined, an additional penalty of 50%–500% of the underpaid tax and enforced collection measures may be imposed.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory Annual Financial Statement Audit Report (年度财务报表审计报告) issued by a PRC-registered CPA firm
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Engaged by the shareholders' meeting or board; the audit opinion is used as supporting disclosure data in the SAMR annual report and must be produced to the STA in-charge bureau upon annual tax settlement or inspection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The audit of the 31 December fiscal year-end must be completed by 30 April of the following year to support the 31 May EIT settlement and the 30 June SAMR annual-report deadlines
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No government filing fine attaches directly, but the absence of a statutory audit renders the annual report and tax settlement legally defective; SAMR may classify the company as non-compliant with abnormal-operations listing, and STA may disallow unverified expenses and charge penalty interest.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for the WFOE irrespective of revenue or asset size: the PRC Company Law requires every limited liability company to prepare annual financial reports and have them audited by an accounting firm at each fiscal year-end; no low-turnover exemption applies, and the audit report must be made available to SAMR and the STA upon request.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (CAS, 企业会计准则), substantially converged with IFRS; the PRC Small Enterprise Accounting Standards (小企业会计准则) are available only to qualifying small enterprises and are not generally adopted by a WFOE subject to foreign-investment information reporting.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: PRC law does not impose an EU-style standalone annual beneficial-owner reconfirmation filing. The WFOE must, first, complete beneficial-owner (受益所有人) registration with the local market regulation bureau within 30 days of incorporation or any control/ownership change under the Beneficial Owner Information Registration Rule (effective 1 November 2024); second, annually confirm and disclose shareholders, shareholding structure, and any equity transfers in the SAMR annual report by 30 June; and third, verify the statutory registers at least once during the annual shareholder-meeting cycle, with share transfers recorded in the Register of Members upon completion of transfer. A Taiwan ultimate investor additionally retains a separate annual mainland-investment operation reporting obligation to the Taiwan MOEA Investment Commission.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300–1,200 per year for registered-address and corporate-secretarial agency services in major Chinese cities; a WFOE using its own leased premises may incur no separate agency fee beyond property costs.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500–6,000 per year for a certified statutory audit of a small-to-mid-size auto-parts e-commerce WFOE by a local licensed CPA firm; add USD 300–900 where the Taiwan parent requires an included or consolidated audit pack.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general CIT holiday. Small profit-seeking enterprises: taxable income not exceeding NT$120,000 is exempt; taxable income above NT$120,000 and up to NT$187,500 is taxed at 1/2 of the excess; above NT$187,500 the flat 20% rate applies. Retained earnings are subject to a 5% surtax. Alternative Minimum Tax applies at 12% of basic income. Investment tax credits for R&D and smart automation are available but not sector-specific for online auto parts retail.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 15 Profit-seeking Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return; e-filed through the Ministry of Finance Electronic Tax Filing Service at tax.nat.gov.tw using the certified eTax software.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within five months after the end of the fiscal year; for a calendar-year enterprise, no later than 31 May. A fiscal-year filer uses the last day of the fifth month after the fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, Taiwan uniform tax ID, registered address, responsible person, business scope code, and shareholders. For a wholly foreign-owned Taiwanese limited company, enter the Taiwanese company name and tax ID.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Taiwan-resident WFOE files as a resident profit-seeking enterprise. Non-resident branches use Form 14; the foreign parent is identified in the shareholder schedule and attached TRC if treaty relief is claimed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Year-end financial position in TWD: cash, receivables, inventory of auto parts, fixed assets, payables, bank debt, and shareholders' equity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident branch filers complete the balance sheet only for Taiwan branch assets and liabilities; the foreign head office account balances are not included.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross online sales revenue, sales returns and allowances, cost of goods sold, gross profit, operating expenses, operating income, non-operating income and expenses. Payment card interchange fees and chargebacks are recorded as expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Taiwan-source e-commerce turnover. Expenses directly attributable to Taiwan sales are deductible; foreign general overhead is allocated using a reasonable apportionment basis acceptable to the tax authority.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconciling items between book profit and taxable income: disallowed expenses, exempt income, domestic dividend exclusion, tax-exempt import duties, and other permanent/temporary adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Taiwan branch cannot claim the same domestic dividend exclusion for remittances to head office; only arm's-length reimbursed expenses are recognized.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 - Taxable Income and Tax Computation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Chargeable taxable income multiplied by the applicable progressive/20% statutory rate. The NT$120,000 small-business exemption and NT$187,500 threshold are applied here.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident branches and non-resident profit-seeking enterprises are taxed at 20% on assessable Taiwan-source income; the small-business exemption applies only to entities with a true local presence and business substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Alternative Minimum Tax computation on book-based basic income at 12%, plus allowable foreign tax credits, investment credits, and any prior-year tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credits for the branch are limited to taxes imposed on the same Taiwan-source income; AMT preferences of the foreign head office are not imported into the branch return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax payable net of provisional tax paid, withholding tax credits, and advance installments. Any balance is due with the return and any overpayment is refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident branches settle through the branch final return and WHT regime rather than the resident shareholders' dividend imputation accounts.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts an additional tax of 10% of the assessed tax amount under Income Tax Act Article 108, plus daily statutory interest on the underpaid amount. Failure to pay after assessment can trigger the Tax Collection Act surcharge of 1% every two days, capped at 15%. If unpaid tax exceeds NT$2,000,000, the responsible person may be subjected to a travel ban and asset-freeze order.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Provisional Income Tax Return (暫繳申報書) filed through the same tax.nat.gov.tw portal and taxpayer software.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Semi-annual (first half of the fiscal year)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing and payment no later than the last day of the ninth month of the fiscal year; for calendar-year enterprises, 30 September. The second half is settled in the annual Form 15 return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimated first-half-year taxable income computed by annualizing actual January-June results or using last year's tax as the presumptive basis.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Taiwan resident WFOE with foreign shareholding uses the same residency basis. Non-resident branches are subject to the same provisional mechanism unless the tax payable is below the de minimis exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 20% statutory CIT rate, subject to the small enterprise exemption and AMT reconciliation at year-end.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The branch must apply the same rate; no specially reduced rate is available for non-resident-owned entities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bank transfer and electronic payment credential evidencing provisional tax remitted to the National Treasury.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments must be remitted from the Taiwan entity's account; head office reimbursement is not a substitute for provisional tax payment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Underpayment of the provisional installment accrues statutory interest until the final return date. Failure to file a provisional return with no later deficiency generally incurs a fixed administrative penalty, and the tax authority may estimate the installment. Deliberate false provisional estimates that facilitate evasion are treated as tax evasion rather than a mere late filing.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A non-resident corporate shareholder must be a tax resident of a jurisdiction with which Taiwan has a comprehensive DTA or the Cross-Strait Tax Agreement. To claim treaty relief, the shareholder must obtain an official Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from its home tax authority, complete a Form for Treaty Benefits/Beneficial Ownership declaration, and deliver these to the Taiwanese WFOE paying the dividend. The withholding agent applies the reduced treaty rate only after the National Taxation Bureau accepts the application; otherwise the 21% statutory WHT is withheld and the foreign shareholder may file a formal refund claim for the excess. Where the Cross-Strait Tax Agreement is in force, Mainland China resident shareholders may claim a maximum 10% dividend WHT (5% for companies holding at least 25% of the capital for the required holding period) supported by a Mainland tax residency certificate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax is 20% for royalties and 20% for interest paid to non-resident companies. Under most Taiwan DTAs, royalties and interest are capped at 10% when the recipient is the beneficial owner and the procedural TRC/Form requirements are met. Royalties for the use of automotive technical know-how require evidence of actual technical service and value creation to avoid recharacterization as undisclosed dividends.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: NT$50,000,000 in aggregate related-party transactions triggers the full Transfer Pricing Report/Local File. NT$20,000,000 triggers simplified contemporaneous documentation, and NT$10,000,000 is the relevance threshold for cross-border transactions with tax-haven related parties. An MNE group with consolidated revenue above Taiwan's CbCR filing threshold (NT$27,000,000,000) must maintain a Master File and file country-by-country reports.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Taiwan does not maintain a separate Economic Substance Regulations regime like the UAE. However, the general anti-avoidance rules in Income Tax Act Articles 43-1, 66-8, and the taxation of resident entities on worldwide income impose a substance-over-form doctrine. A Taiwanese WFOE must demonstrate real business management locally, keep accounting records in Taiwan, have local employees or physical infrastructure, and make substantive business decisions in Taiwan. A shell WFOE without local economic activity will be denied treaty benefits, may be treated as a tax haven vehicle under CFC rules, and can have its taxable profit recharacterized to the beneficial owner.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Suppressing online retail sales, booking fake purchase invoices for auto parts, inflating COGS, maintaining undisclosed offshore payment wallets, or using forged delivery documents to understate taxable income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Income Tax Act Article 110, intentional underreporting gives rise to an additional tax of up to 200% of the underpaid CIT. Criminal conviction under Tax Collection Act Article 41 carries imprisonment of up to five years, detention, and fines up to NT$6,000,000. The tax authority is authorized to examine bank deposits and third-party payment settlement records to reconstruct income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false returns or direct the concealment are personally liable for the underpaid tax to the extent of unjust enrichment. The National Taxation Bureau may impose leave restrictions and asset attachment under Tax Collection Act when corporate arrears exceed NT$2,000,000. Individual prosecution and imprisonment apply when fraud is proven.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a Taiwanese WFOE as a paper entity with no office, employees, or board meetings in Taiwan; using the Taiwan entity as an invoice pass-through for Mainland suppliers and Taiwan customers; claiming treaty or residency benefits without genuine management and business purpose.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax authorities may apply general anti-avoidance rules to disregard the shell entity, reattribute the e-commerce sales income to the true economic owner, deny the treaty/TRC claim, and reassess 20% CIT with an additional penalty of generally not less than 2x the underpaid tax until the deficiency is paid. The commercial authority may also revoke company registration for a dormant filing company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced in cases of fraud or sham arrangements; directors who participated in the shell structure may be personally assessed for unpaid corporate taxes. Travel bans, suspension of passport rights, and, in egregious cases, criminal liability for tax evasion may follow. Liquidation distribution from a shell company to foreign shareholders without settling tax liabilities creates personal recourse against the liquidator.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling auto parts to a related Hong Kong or Mainland trading company at a margin below the automotive e-commerce industry benchmark; paying inflated management fees or royalties to the foreign parent without documentary support; using intercompany loans with excessive interest to strip the Taiwan profit base.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The National Taxation Bureau may adjust the transfer price under Income Tax Act Article 43-1, recalculate taxable income, and assess an underpayment penalty plus daily statutory interest. Failure to maintain a Transfer Pricing Report where required results in an administrative fine of NT$3,000 to NT$30,000 and materially aggravates the penalty on any adjustment. For AMT purposes, the adjusted amount could also trigger the 12% basic tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve or execute non-arm's-length related-party contracts may be jointly liable for the resulting tax deficiency if the contract is found to be a sham or has no valid business purpose. The tax authority may seek to attach personal assets of the responsible person when the corporate entity is insolvent or was used as the alter ego of the shareholder.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding Tax Violations on Profit Repatriation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Remitting dividends to a foreign parent without the 21% withholding, or disguising dividends as loan principal repayment, consulting fees, or royalty payments to circumvent the statutory WHT. Misclassifying interest or royalties as trade receivables to create a low-tax outflow.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Taiwanese entity, as withholding agent, becomes liable for the unwithheld tax and is fined an amount not less than the equivalent of 15% and not more than three times the unwithheld tax. Interest accrues from the original due date. Intentional mischaracterization is viewed as tax evasion under Tax Collection Act and transfers criminal exposure to the signatories.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The responsible officer and finance director are personally liable for the unremitted withholding tax if they knowingly signed the remittance instruction. The National Taxation Bureau may order a travel ban and prohibit property transfers. Criminal imprisonment of up to five years is possible for deliberate failure to withhold or remit.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering Through E-Commerce Payment Rails
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring Wirecard, Stripe, PayPal, and bank settlement flows to stay below NT$500,000/large transaction reporting thresholds; repeatedly splitting receivables among shell accounts; commingling business funds with the foreign shareholder's personal wallet; or moving defense-sensitive or sanctioned-country payments through the Taiwan entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Money Laundering Control Act, conviction for money-laundering activities involving illegal tax proceeds is punishable by imprisonment of up to seven years and a fine of up to NT$50,000,000. The financial intelligence unit may freeze the company's Stripe/PayPal and bank accounts on suspicion, and the tax authority may impute unreported income using bank deposit analysis and third-party payment settlement data.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are statutory AML compliance officers for the entity even in online commerce. Personal liability attaches for failing to implement transaction monitoring. In money-laundering convictions, personal assets derived from the offence are confiscated; travel bans and extradition risk may apply. The 'responsible person' can be imprisoned separately from the corporate entity.
